name: Proving Grounds - a healer, and an integration check for the air asymmetry
notes: Mario's third requested design, plus a composition check for the first: behavior: support seeks the nearest wounded ally instead of the nearest hostile (perception.ts's woundedAlliesOf), and AttackKind 'heal' clamps at maxHp instead of zero (applyHeal, a heal.applied event of its own). Flying, as Clash of Clans' own Healer is, so this field also answers whether ally-seeking composes with the ground-air asymmetry built for the skyraider: the grunt should never be able to touch the medic (targetLayers excludes air), the flaktrooper should (no such restriction) - the same pairing as bench-sky-ground-asymmetry, now escorting a fight instead of standing alone.
